text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Yasuda Kinen drew near.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, we have decided to hold a joint 
press conference for Gran Alegria-san and 
Almond Eye-san.”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Together with Ai-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
No, the press conferences will be held 
individually.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll get ready for the Q&A 
session!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-senpai's influence really is amazing! 
Interview requests are up 0.3 miles 
compared to our usual!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Just as expected of everyone's idol!
choice_data_list:
Gran's also getting a lot of attention for 
her ability!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"‘If anyone can take down Almond Eye, it 
would have to be Gran Alegria’, you say?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the way you phrased that totally 
assumes Ai-senpai won't lose, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone believes Ai-senpai is the 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Which means— if I win, it'll 
definitively prove I'm the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Proof of being the strongest— To carry on 
Master's teachings, that result is 
necessary."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Can one become stronger with 'Uma Musume 
First'?―― To show the answer to that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We reached the pinnacle through guidance 
that doesn't push Umamusume too hard. It 
is through results that the worth of a 
training method is truly proven.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To spread 'Uma Musume First', I will 
defeat Almond Eye and obtain proof that I 
am the strongest――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the press conference before the Yasuda 
Kinen, Almond Eye was the first to take 
the stage.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Conditioning is going smoothly. I will 
have myself in perfect shape by the day of 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Is there any Umamusume in particular 
you're keeping an eye on for the Yasuda 
Kinen?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan... Gran Alegria-chan, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Gran-san does excel at the mile, after 
all! Is her speed still a major threat?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, speed. However... speed is my weapon 
too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let anyone say she's faster. I'm 
not yielding on speed, either."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The strongest—is me. If she's coming with 
speed—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll crush her with pure speed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A sudden stir rippled among the reporters 
on the other side of the monitor."
choice_data_list: This is a declaration of war on Gran...

It's a declaration of war against Gran, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahahaha! Nice, nice! Ai-senpai, 
you're the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
80 mph has really fired me up! It's 
getting super intense!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll— take you up on that 
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding the Yasuda Kinen, Almond 
Eye-san mentioned she's keeping an eye on 
you, Gran-san—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The one I'm keeping an eye on is Ai-senpai 
too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara, a world record, and 
even conquering overseas races—Eye-senpai 
is truly incredible!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I can certainly see why she's called the 
strongest active racer!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: In other words, Ai is a formidable foe...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Of course! Howeverâ

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you want a battle of speed, I'll 
overwhelm you with mine!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The Yasuda Kinen is my home turf. And I 
am the Mile Queen!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A massive crowd had packed into Tokyo 
Racecourse for the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
If Almond Eye wins today, that's insane! 
She'll add yet another GⅠ victory to her 
name!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Even among all the Umamusume hailed 
as the strongest, none could break the 
record of 7 turf GⅠ wins for the longest 
time. Ai just might be the one to rewrite 
history!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I made an Ai-chan cheer fanâª I can't 
wait for the race and the Winning Live!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
They have Ai-chan plushies! Mommy, buy me 
an Ai-chan, please~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected, Ai-san's popularity and 
reputation are incredible...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I just hope this hostile atmosphere 
doesn't affect Gran-chan."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—it is concerning. Gran lit a fire 
under Ai during the press conference, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san's overwhelming strength— running 
beside her, it's almost terrifying."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Bouquet-san, you accompanied Eye-san 
on her Dubai campaign... didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I had the opportunity to help out 
with tandem training and other tasks.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...A-Almond Eye-san is someone whose 
status as a legend seems practically 
guaranteed already...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A legend is not an opponent an ordinary 
Umamusume can beat. Throughout history, 
that is an undeniable fact...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
After all, the older generation has been 
competing against the likes of Ayi-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If even we couldn't win, it can't be 
helped...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Woah~, Ai-senpai's popularity is 
incredible!
choice_data_list: You've got a pretty diverse fanbase, huh.
You've got such a diverse fanbase, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's true. It feels like there are a lot 
of fans who are watching a race for the 
first time!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"That's probably because Ai-senpai is 
being featured on regular news and in 
newspapers."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even people who don't watch the Twinkle 
Series know who Almond Eye is!
choice_data_list:
You seem different than usual, are you 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! I don't mind in the 
slightest!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's my rule! "Fire myself up 
with a whistle when it's crunch time!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ai-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan, looking forward to working with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even on your main battleground—I'm the one 
who will win.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Beating a serious, 120-mph Ai-senpai is 
what it takes to be the strongest, right?!
